title: 云门试炼：第三声钟
cn: 沈砚入门三年，始终没有引来一缕灵气。第三声钟响起时，试炼石却在他掌下泛起微光，像是沉睡多年的火星。
众人都说那只是一点巧合。沈砚没有争辩，只把每日引气的时间从一刻延长到三刻，用耐心磨炼自己的心性。
石阶尽头，一位气势强大的师兄故意挡住去路。沈砚察觉对方在隐藏真正的境界，于是收起急躁，借山风的间隙完成了突破。
en: After three years, Shen Yan was still an unremarkable [[disciple]]. When the third bell rang, a faint glow appeared beneath his palm, as if [[spiritual]] fire had awakened.
Everyone called it luck. Shen Yan did not argue. He extended his daily practice and used [[perseverance]] to [[temper]] his impatient mind.

At the end of the stairs stood a [[formidable]] senior who tried to block his way. Shen Yan sensed a power he meant to [[conceal]], stayed calm, and finally made a [[breakthrough]] into a new [[realm]].

title: 归墟灯影
cn: 归墟秘境的入口只在月蚀时出现。林照在残墙下发现一盏古灯，灯身刻着晦涩的铭文，旁边还压着一枚无人知晓来历的遗物。
她本想把灯带回宗门，却听见灯芯里传来第二种呼吸声。那不是吉兆。她没有贸然召唤其中的东西，而是先沿着灰尘留下的痕迹调查。
月影移过墙缝，灯火突然熄灭。下一瞬，同行的师弟凭空消失，只剩一行湿漉漉的脚印，向着禁地深处延伸。
en: The entrance to the ruins appeared only during an eclipse. Lin Zhao found an [[ancient]] lamp beneath a broken wall. Its [[obscure]] [[inscription]] surrounded a forgotten [[relic]].
She heard a second breath inside the lamp. It felt like an [[omen]]. Rather than [[summon]] whatever waited there, she decided to [[investigate]] the dust and the broken seals.
When moonlight crossed the wall, the flame went out. Her companion seemed to [[vanish]] without a trace, leaving wet footprints that led towards the forbidden chamber.

title: 借月问剑
cn: 月下问剑，先问心。顾停分辨不出师父留下的两道剑痕有什么不同，只知道其中一道总让他想起自己的骄傲。
对手不断挑衅，逼他先出剑。顾停握紧剑柄，却想起师父说过，真正的剑修必须有克制，不能让怒意替自己做决定。
决胜一刻，他没有刺向对手，而是转身挡住落石。那一剑不够凌厉，却让他明白：陪伴与守护同样深刻，面对恐惧比赢下比试更重要。
en: Under the moon, Gu Ting tried to [[discern]] the difference between two sword marks. One of them revealed a pride he had never admitted.
His opponent continued to [[provoke]] him. Gu Ting held the hilt tightly, then chose [[restraint]] instead of anger.
At the [[decisive]] moment, he turned to block falling stones. The choice taught him a [[profound]] lesson: to [[confront]] fear and keep a [[vow]] mattered more than victory.

title: 药谷失窃案
cn: 药谷最珍贵的月魄草在守夜时失窃。负责炼丹的弟子说自己一直在配药，可药柜上留下了一枚伪造的封印。
所有人的怀疑都指向新来的杂役。沈砚没有急着定罪，而是沿着药香和泥水混合的痕迹，逐一核对每个人的动机。
真相藏在废弃的炼丹房：月魄草被用来救一只受伤的灵兽。沈砚找回药草，也留下了一份更温和的药方。

The theft raised [[suspicion]] around a new servant. Shen Yan followed a faint [[trace]] of mud and herbs, asking what [[motive]] each person might have.

cn: 雷云压在雪峰上，像一场即将降临的灾难。叶蘅独自站在阵心，知道这次渡劫不会有人替她承受。
第一道天雷落下，她用剑阵抵挡。第二道雷击碎了阵旗，她在动荡的灵力中想起师父教过的事：修炼不是追赶别人，而是培养能够忍受漫长孤独的心。
黎明前，叶蘅从黑暗和风雪中走出。她没有变得更强大到无所畏惧，却已经能够带着恐惧继续前行。

The first bolt struck the formation. The second created violent [[turbulence]]. She remembered that to [[cultivate]] was also to [[endure]] a long and [[solitary]] road.
Before dawn, she began to [[emerge]] from the snow. She was not fearless, but the trial had begun to [[transform]] her spirit.

cn: 观星台每夜记录天体轨迹，用来预测秘境开启的时间。负责推演的陆微发现，三颗星的位置出现了细微偏差。
长老认为那只是罕见天象，不值得打乱计划。陆微却重新计算距离，提出一个大胆假设：异常不是来自天空，而是来自地脉。
当她把阵图转向山腹，沉睡多年的灵脉终于显露。她没有预测到答案，却学会了先承认自己的模型可能不完整。

监控画面和他的说法互相矛盾：画面里，他在另一个出口停留了七分钟。那是可疑的细节，却还不能证明他就是凶手。
程雾核实了每一条线索，最后发现真正的关键是雨水冲掉的鞋印。凶手借人群离开，却没有注意到地面反光。

警方根据她拍下的证据拦截了交易。真正重要的不是箱子里的钱，而是那些能让无数人消失在系统里的名字。

有人不断用广播操纵她的感知，让她相信出口就在错误的方向。她几乎绝望时，想起画家留下的提示：最真实的声音不会要求你立刻相信它。
苏禾关掉广播，沿着回声找到暗门。镜子可以扭曲真相，但不能替人解释动机。

顾言没有立刻回复。他先采取预防措施，复制档案、通知律师，再去谈判对方想要的东西。对方的计划开始崩塌，因为每一次威胁都留下了记录。
午夜前，顾言公开了真正的证据。他知道任何选择都有后果，却不再让恐惧替自己决定。

cn: 海洋研究员在礁石边录到一段规律的低鸣。海浪足以淹没普通声音，但这段信号在同一频率上重复出现。
团队提出了海底设备故障的假设，却无法解释录音中夹杂的人声。为了重现声音，他们把设备放进水下，等待潮汐改变。
第二次录音证实那不是幻听。信号来自一座废弃灯塔，里面藏着一台仍在发射的旧式电台。
en: The researchers recorded a low [[acoustic]] sound by the sea. Waves could [[drown]] out most voices, but this [[signal]] repeated at a specific [[frequency]].
Their first [[hypothesis]] involved a broken underwater device. They studied the [[transmission]] and tried to [[reproduce]] the sound.
The second recording proved that the voice was real. The source was an abandoned lighthouse, not a natural [[marine]] phenomenon.

words.example: The researchers recorded a low acoustic sound by the sea.

words.example: Waves could drown out most voices, but this signal repeated at a specific frequency.

words.example: Their first hypothesis involved a broken underwater device.

words.example: They studied the transmission and tried to reproduce the sound.

words.meaning: 重现；复制
words.example: They studied the transmission and tried to reproduce the sound.

words.meaning: 海洋的
words.example: The source was an abandoned lighthouse, not a natural marine phenomenon.

title: 纸上密码
cn: 死者桌上只有一张画满圆点的纸。警察以为那是随手涂鸦，密码爱好者秦遥却发现数字顺序每隔七位重复。
她从日期中推导出一组坐标，随后破译出一句话：不要相信第一份报告。那些看似混乱的图案，其实是故意留下的提醒。
纸张背面还有一段加密文件。秦遥把两段信息拼在一起，得到一个连贯的解释：案件从一开始就被人改写过。
en: The dead man's desk held a page covered with dots. Qin Yao noticed a repeated [[sequence]] and began to break the [[cipher]].
She managed to [[derive]] coordinates and [[decipher]] a sentence. The strange [[pattern]] was a [[deliberate]] warning, not random ink.
A second file had been [[encrypt|encrypted]] on the back. Together, the clues produced a [[coherent]] explanation.

words.meaning: 顺序；序列
words.example: Qin Yao noticed a repeated sequence and began to break the cipher.

words.meaning: 密码；暗号
words.example: Qin Yao noticed a repeated sequence and began to break the cipher.

words.example: She managed to derive coordinates and decipher a sentence.

words.meaning: 破译
words.example: She managed to derive coordinates and decipher a sentence.

words.example: The strange pattern was a deliberate warning, not random ink.

words.meaning: 故意的；深思熟虑的
words.example: The strange pattern was a deliberate warning, not random ink.

words.meaning: 加密
words.example: A second file had been encrypted on the back.

words.meaning: 连贯的
words.example: Together, the clues produced a coherent explanation.

title: 无人证词
cn: 庭审中没有目击者，只有一份自动生成的语音记录。检察官认为它足以证明被告在场，辩护律师却指出录音前后有三处不一致。
年轻的技术员终于清晰说明，系统会把背景噪声当成人声补全。原本“没有人证”并不等于没有证据，而是提醒所有人重新检查假设。
法官要求进行客观复核，最后推翻了草率的判决。真正可靠的裁决，必须允许人们对它提出上诉。
en: There was no witness, only an automatic recording. The [[prosecutor]] claimed it proved presence, but the defense questioned its [[credibility]] because the account was [[inconsistent]].
The technician finally managed to [[articulate]] how the system filled background noise with invented words. The old [[assumption]] needed to be challenged.
After an [[objective]] review, the judge refused to accept a rushed [[verdict]]. The defense decided to [[appeal]] the decision.

words.meaning: 检察官
words.example: The prosecutor claimed it proved presence, but the defense questioned its credibility because the account was inconsistent.

words.meaning: 可信度
words.example: The prosecutor claimed it proved presence, but the defense questioned its credibility because the account was inconsistent.

words.meaning: 不一致的
words.example: The prosecutor claimed it proved presence, but the defense questioned its credibility because the account was inconsistent.

words.meaning: 清晰表达
words.example: The technician finally managed to articulate how the system filled background noise with invented words.

words.meaning: 假定；假设
words.example: The old assumption needed to be challenged.

words.meaning: 客观的
words.example: After an objective review, the judge refused to accept a rushed verdict.

words.meaning: 裁决；判决
words.example: After an objective review, the judge refused to accept a rushed verdict.

words.meaning: 上诉
words.example: The defense decided to appeal the decision.

title: 山契
cn: 山脚的水井一夜枯了。宗门账册却写着，今年灵脉的[[output|产出]]比去年更多。掌事要沈砚先向村民收取供奉，他站在井边，没有把征收令拿出来。井底的绳结仍是湿的，说明水并不是慢慢干涸的。
他沿山势查到一条新开的支渠。把灵水引向内门花园的命令盖着师父的印。沈砚请求[[suspend|暂停]]引水，直到双方重新商定山契。师父没有回答，只把那枚印章推到他面前：明日议事，你来说明理由。
en: The records reported a higher [[output]], but the village well was dry.
Shen Yan asked the council to [[suspend]] the diversion of water.

words.meaning: 产出
words.example: The records reported a higher output, but the village well was dry.

words.meaning: 暂停
words.example: Shen Yan asked the council to suspend the diversion of water.

title: 渡口的空舟
cn: 摆渡人说，昨夜他只载了三个人。岸边却留着四双鞋，河上的空舟也比平日沉。林照想直接下水，老船工拦住她，让她先看船沿：四处受力的痕迹并不[[symmetrical|对称]]。
第四个乘客并没有登舟。有人把装着铁砂的布袋绑在船侧，制造船满的假象。林照终于找到失踪者藏身的苇荡，却没有立刻问罪；眼前的人满身伤痕，需要先得到[[shelter|庇护]]，再说明逃亡的原因。
en: The marks on the boat were not [[symmetrical]].
The injured traveler needed [[shelter]] before he could explain his escape.

words.meaning: 对称
words.example: The marks on the boat were not symmetrical.

words.meaning: 庇护
words.example: The injured traveler needed shelter before he could explain his escape.

title: 旧阵新雪
cn: 守山阵在雪夜熄灭，执事把错归给刚入门的弟子。陆微发现，阵旗所用的铜线已经被盐雾[[corrode|腐蚀]]，外面新刷的红漆只是遮住了裂纹。这个错误比一个弟子的疏忽古老得多。
她把每一段铜线按安装日期排开，发现账册中的维修从未发生。修好阵法不够，还必须[[rectify|纠正]]记录。天亮后，陆微把损坏的铜线放上议事桌，要求以后每次维修都留下两个人的签字。
en: Salt can [[corrode]] the copper beneath a coat of paint.
Lu Wei asked the council to [[rectify]] the maintenance records.

words.meaning: 腐蚀
words.example: Salt can corrode the copper beneath a coat of paint.

words.meaning: 纠正
words.example: Lu Wei asked the council to rectify the maintenance records.

title: 丹炉余温
cn: 丹师声称自己整晚不在药房，炉壁却还有余温。叶蘅没有立即质疑，因为厚铜也可能缓慢散热。她取来一只相同的炉，记录冷却速度，用它作为[[comparison|对照]]，直到夜深。
两只炉温差很大。丹师终于承认，他为重病的师妹用了禁药，但没有人能保证疗效。叶蘅请医修评估每一种[[hazard|风险]]，并守在榻边。她宁愿面对漫长的不确定，也不愿把一次冒险叫作奇迹。
en: She used a second furnace for [[comparison]].
Every possible [[hazard]] had to be considered before treatment.

words.meaning: 对照
words.example: She used a second furnace for comparison.

words.meaning: 风险
words.example: Every possible hazard had to be considered before treatment.

title: 藏书阁的缺页
cn: 剑谱最后一页不见了，顾停以为有人偷走秘法。他逐字核对旧抄本，发现被删掉的其实是一条[[restriction|限制]]：施术者必须在日落前解除剑阵，否则阵中生灵都会受伤。
缺页让剑法显得完美，也让练习者看不见代价。顾停请阁主把警示补回，并把自己失败的记录作为[[appendix|附录]]留在书后。他明白，完整的传承也应当包含前人的错误。
en: The missing page described an important [[restriction]].
Gu Ting added his failed attempts as an [[appendix]].

words.meaning: 限制
words.example: The missing page described an important restriction.

words.meaning: 附录
words.example: Gu Ting added his failed attempts as an appendix.

title: 无名碑
cn: 山门后有一块无字碑，弟子们把它当作练剑的石头。清扫落叶时，林照看见碑底磨损的姓氏。碑上的名字不是被雨水洗去，而是有人故意[[erase|抹掉]]的。
旧籍记着一位因反对开山而被逐的医修。山洪来时，恰是她留下的林地护住村落。林照没有擅自替她写传记，而是请村民各自[[recollect|回忆]]见过的事，让矛盾的证言并列留在碑旁。
en: Someone had tried to [[erase]] the name from the stone.
The villagers were asked to [[recollect]] what they had actually seen.

words.meaning: 抹掉
words.example: Someone had tried to erase the name from the stone.

words.meaning: 回忆
words.example: The villagers were asked to recollect what they had actually seen.

title: 灵田边界
cn: 两家宗门争夺一块灵田，界碑却在夜里挪动了三尺。测地师陆微先看苔痕，再量溪岸。每个人都宣称自己的地图最[[accurate|准确]]，可地图画的是二十年前的河道。
她把旧河床的位置标在地上，建议沿现有水源共同灌溉。双方不愿放弃权属，却同意先[[cooperate|合作]]度过旱季。陆微没有称这为和解；她只是把第一份共同签字的用水记录收好。
en: An old map is not always an [[accurate]] guide to a changing river.
The two schools agreed to [[cooperate]] during the drought.

words.meaning: 准确
words.example: An old map is not always an accurate guide to a changing river.

words.meaning: 合作
words.example: The two schools agreed to cooperate during the drought.

title: 听风塔
cn: 塔中风铃连响七次，守塔人说敌人将至。沈砚登塔时却发现新挂的铜铃比旧铃轻。预警的[[mechanism|机制]]已经改变，可值守的人仍按旧规则解释声音。
他们卸下铃铛分别测试，发现大风也会触发警报。沈砚提出一套临时[[procedure|流程]]：铃响后先查风向，再派两人去山口核实。夜里铃声重起，弟子们终于没有盲目拔剑。
en: The warning [[mechanism]] had changed after the bells were replaced.
They introduced a new [[procedure]] for checking each alarm.

words.meaning: 机制
words.example: The warning mechanism had changed after the bells were replaced.

words.meaning: 流程
words.example: They introduced a new procedure for checking each alarm.

title: 雾谷借火
cn: 雾谷的地火突然衰弱，过冬的村民向宗门借火。掌事担心储备[[insufficient|不足]]，只肯借给付得起灵石的人。叶蘅看着被拒在门外的孩子，拿出过去三年的消耗记录。
若把无人居住的炼器室暂时停用，省下的火足够村民熬过寒潮。她并未凭同情否认资源限制，而是重新[[allocate|分配]]有限的储备。第一辆运火车离开时，炼器室的灯一盏盏熄了。
en: The steward feared that the remaining fuel was [[insufficient]].
Ye Heng proposed a different way to [[allocate]] the reserves.

words.meaning: 不足
words.example: The steward feared that the remaining fuel was insufficient.

words.meaning: 分配
words.example: Ye Heng proposed a different way to allocate the reserves.

title: 一寸剑锋
cn: 铸剑师说，薄一寸的剑锋会更快。顾停试剑时却看见刃口细小的缺痕。追求速度的[[pursuit|追求]]若不受约束，就会把使用者也算作耗材。他把剑还到炉前，请师傅再做一次抗折试验。
剑在第五次试验中裂开。年轻的铸剑师很羞愧，顾停却保存了碎片。他们需要一条可以重复验证的[[criterion|标准]]，而不是一次恰巧成功的演示。下一把剑更重，也更可靠。
en: The [[pursuit]] of speed had weakened the blade.
Repeated testing gave them a clear [[criterion]] for safety.

words.meaning: 追求
words.example: The pursuit of speed had weakened the blade.

words.meaning: 标准
words.example: Repeated testing gave them a clear criterion for safety.

title: 归途灯笼
cn: 秘境关闭前，众人争抢最后一条山道。林照看见一位不肯走的老人，他坚持孙女还在谷底。其余人把这句话当作[[illusion|幻觉]]，因为名册上没有那个名字。
林照重新核对入谷记录，发现孩子用的是乳名。她与向导折返，在枯井旁找到女孩。救援耽误了行程，他们只能放弃灵石，换取足够的绳索。每个人都付出了[[sacrifice|牺牲]]，才把灯笼带回山外。
en: The old man’s memory was dismissed as an [[illusion]].
The rescue required a real [[sacrifice]] from everyone involved.

words.meaning: 幻觉
words.example: The old man’s memory was dismissed as an illusion.

words.meaning: 牺牲
words.example: The rescue required a real sacrifice from everyone involved.

title: 封山之后
cn: 山门因瘟疫封闭，药材却只能从山下运来。医修们争论是否应当彻底[[isolate|隔离]]所有人，叶蘅把药棚移到界碑旁，划出交接和休息的区域。恐惧没有因此消失，但工作开始有了秩序。
她每天记录新病人数、用药量和饮水来源，不把短暂下降当成痊愈。数周后，证据终于足以支持放宽禁令。叶蘅将这种[[gradual|逐步的]]恢复写进日志，末尾仍留着空白，等待明日的新情况。
en: The healers had to [[isolate]] sick patients while keeping supplies moving.
The records supported a [[gradual]] return to ordinary life.

words.meaning: 隔离
words.example: The healers had to isolate sick patients while keeping supplies moving.

words.meaning: 逐步的
words.example: The records supported a gradual return to ordinary life.

title: 慢了四分钟的钟
cn: 证人说，九点整听见楼上传来响声。程雾看了看墙钟，又核对车站的报时记录：这只钟每天都慢四分钟。所谓精确的[[chronology|时间顺序]]，其实建立在两个不同的时间标准上。
把时间统一后，嫌疑人已在公共汽车上，车内录像也能证实。程雾从名单上划去他的名字，再回到现场。纠正一个时间[[discrepancy|差异]]没有告诉她谁犯了案，却避免让无辜的人替空白作答。
en: The [[chronology]] depended on clocks that did not agree.
Correcting the [[discrepancy]] ruled out one suspect.

words.meaning: 时间顺序
words.example: The chronology depended on clocks that did not agree.

words.meaning: 差异
words.example: Correcting the discrepancy ruled out one suspect.

title: 电梯第十三层
cn: 大楼没有十三层，维修单上却连续出现这个编号。保安说那是打印错误，许棠注意到每张单据的金额都刚好低于人工审核的[[threshold|门槛]]。错误很小，重复起来却很整齐。
她把半年记录交给审计员，发现设备编号也不存在。虚构的楼层只是用来[[disguise|掩饰]]重复报销。真正的线索不是一扇神秘的门，而是每次都有人选择不去问的那串数字。
en: Each claim stayed just below the review [[threshold]].
The invented floor helped [[disguise]] repeated claims.

words.meaning: 门槛
words.example: Each claim stayed just below the review threshold.

words.meaning: 掩饰
words.example: The invented floor helped disguise repeated claims.

title: 第二把钥匙
cn: 房门没有撬痕，屋主坚称钥匙从未离身。顾舟没有由此断定窃贼熟悉屋主。他在抽屉里找到一张旧收据：三年前，维修工曾为门锁做过一个[[duplicate|复制品]]。
锁店留存的领用记录指向前任租客，却不能证明是他作案。顾舟继续查门禁，发现钥匙被装在公共应急箱里。只有证明谁实际取用过，才能把可能性变成可靠的[[inference|推断]]。
en: A [[duplicate]] of the key had been made three years earlier.
An [[inference]] about guilt required more than access to a key.

words.meaning: 复制品
words.example: A duplicate of the key had been made three years earlier.

words.meaning: 推断
words.example: An inference about guilt required more than access to a key.

title: 失焦的合影
cn: 毕业合影里，失踪者的脸恰好模糊。有人说照片被动过手脚，苏禾却先调出原始文件。模糊区域与其他走动者方向相同，符合长曝光造成的[[distortion|失真]]。
她没有从模糊的脸上猜测情绪，而是查看玻璃门的倒影。门里映出一只当晚才运来的展柜。这证明拍摄时间与标注日期不符；照片的[[authenticity|真实性]]和标题的准确性，是两件需要分别核对的事。
en: The blur was a natural [[distortion]] caused by movement.
The [[authenticity]] of an image does not guarantee an accurate caption.

words.meaning: 失真
words.example: The blur was a natural distortion caused by movement.

words.meaning: 真实性
words.example: The authenticity of an image does not guarantee an accurate caption.

title: 末班邮件
cn: 死者电脑在深夜发出邮件，似乎证明他还活着。技术员先检查系统，发现邮件使用了[[automatic|自动的]]定时发送。发件时间只能证明程序执行，不能证明有人坐在桌前。
草稿最后编辑于下午，附件却晚了六小时。两种记录来自不同账户。程雾要求保存服务器副本，再检查访问[[permission|权限]]。她把“谁能做到”与“谁实际做了”分在笔记两栏里。
en: The message had been sent by an [[automatic]] scheduler.
The team reviewed each account’s [[permission]] to modify the attachment.

words.meaning: 自动的
words.example: The message had been sent by an automatic scheduler.

words.meaning: 权限
words.example: The team reviewed each account’s permission to modify the attachment.

title: 白色纤维
cn: 窗框上一根白线与嫌疑人的围巾颜色相同，众人都以为找到了关键。检验员提醒，颜色一致只说明它们可能属于同一[[category|类别]]；这类纤维在全市数千件衣服里都能找到。
围巾确实接触过窗框，却是在案发后救人时留下的。新证词让时间顺序清楚起来。检验员在报告中保留了最初结果，并补充它的[[limitation|局限]]，而不是偷偷把不合期待的部分删掉。
en: The two fibers belonged to a common [[category]].
The report explained the [[limitation]] of that finding.

words.meaning: 类别
words.example: The two fibers belonged to a common category.

words.meaning: 局限
words.example: The report explained the limitation of that finding.

title: 地下水声
cn: 空置商场夜里总有水声，物业称管线早已关闭。许棠看见水表仍在缓慢转动，便在不同时间记录读数，试着找出用量与营业时间的[[correlation|相关性]]。结果显示，水声只在隔壁餐厅打烊后出现。
排查发现一根未经登记的管道，通向地下清洗间。相关并不能证明偷水，却帮助确定检查方向。物业最终安装了独立[[meter|计量表]]，旧账也交由双方核对，传言中的“地下哭声”有了普通的来源。
en: She looked for a [[correlation]] between water use and closing time.
A separate [[meter]] made future water use visible.

words.meaning: 相关性
words.example: She looked for a correlation between water use and closing time.

words.meaning: 计量表

title: 遗嘱上的逗号

河流加速，丰沛的灵气涌来。他凭能力稳住船身，绝不放弃寻找导师。随后他才发现，导师正在下游保护那位证人。

title: 原子灯拍卖
cn: 拍卖会上，一盏宣传为“原子灯”的灯吸引了观众。它的漂亮光效是主要卖点，但密封破损使气压变化时有气体泄入室内。示意图上画着原子；律师提醒梅阅读附带说明。

她发现一条被删去的风险提示，随即阻止了演示。买家改变态度，拍卖停止；她把危险归因于隐瞒，观众都平安离开。

A diagram showed an [[atom]]; an [[attorney]] asked Mei to read the lamp’s [[attachment]].

An [[attentive]] [[attendant]] would [[attach]] the note. It said the lamp must [[attain]] steady pressure before any [[attempt]] to light it. A quaint word, [[attent]], meaning attentive, made Mei pay closer [[attention]] while buyers [[attend|attended]] the demonstration.
She found a deleted warning and stopped a possible [[attack]] of fumes. Buyers changed their [[attitude]]; she would [[attribute]] the risk to concealment, not magic. Everyone left safely.

cn: 梅得奖后收到一根古老的车轴，据说来自公元前300年。送礼者的背景模糊，一个单身考古学者提出帮她检查。

cn: 羽毛球赛后，一名秃头银行家在阳台上吃了培根，病得很重。徽章显示他支持芭蕾剧院，行李里却发现了投票文件。

cn: 男爵在宴会上讨价还价，要买下荒地。理发师却说，运大麦的驳船从未到过谷仓，酒吧那面旗帜只是掩饰。
梅走到谷仓，只见空桶和裸露的地板。男爵的狗叫得厉害；气压计显示风暴将至，一道路障挡住归路。
一名包扎着手臂的强盗撞开障碍，向空中鸣枪。他竟是被欠工资的船夫。梅找到卖地款，帮助双方结清，枪声才停。

cn: 市场旁的一处基地以棒球学校作掩护。梅从海湾沙滩跟踪嫌疑人，发现地下室有浴室、面粉和一批奇怪的电池。
她原以为这是一座武器工厂。基本证据却指向别处：浴盆旁的球棒沾着面糊，嫌疑人只是在给义卖做糕点。
真正的争斗发生在楼上，竞争商贩想夺走募款。梅以海湾运输单作为依据，查清资金来源，洗清了嫌疑人的名声。

title: 蜂巢边的许愿珠
cn: 一个新手乞丐拾到一颗漂亮珠子，相信它能让妖兽听话。他把珠子挂在胡须上，坐在横梁下，怀里装满豆子。

林遥教他观察行为而不是妄求控制。少年改变举止，把珠子放回池边；从那以后，他的修行真正开始。

title: 长凳下的浆果酒
cn: 村民把有益的浆果酒赐给救人的姑娘。她将腰带放在长凳上，弯腰去拿下面的酒，却听见朋友劝她小心。

他帮助检查饮料，证明它对伤者有益而且无害。姑娘将药送给心爱的家人，村民终于不再被流言迷惑。

cn: 主教拍卖自己的传记，为出生有缺陷的儿童筹款。书目旁夹着圣经和生物学笔记，竞拍者宣称这本书值十亿元。

她让印刷员重新装订真实版本，竞价恢复合理。主教放下怨恨：关于生命的技术应服务家庭，而不该制造荒唐的神迹。

林遥清理危险，给男孩检查瘀伤。黎明的光线越来越亮，孩子重新快步走过小溪；真正的精彩是他安全归来。

title: 作曲家的复合墙
cn: 作曲家完成作品前，邻居投诉石墙传来的噪声。梅编写投诉记录，发现复杂的墙体使普通音符听起来异常尖锐。

被告获释，负责人员学会应对证据的不确定性。梅说，确信不能代替有说服力的证据；便利也不能成为偷懒的理由。

cn: 顾客习惯每天来买奶，切割机里却传来异常声响。林遥看到潮湿的水坝下，一个气缸正不断循环工作。
可爱的木偶飞镖误入机械，有人愤怒咒骂，有人嘲笑这位勇敢的学徒。他仍敢冲上前，保护心爱的小妹妹。
他停下机器，避免了严重损害。惯常的做法被重新审查；奶场主终于承认，危险必须每天检查，不能靠冷嘲热讽掩盖。
en: A [[customer]]’s [[daily]] visit to a [[dairy]] followed a [[custom]]: watch a [[cute]] puppet beside a [[cutter]]. Under a [[damp]] [[dam]], a [[cylinder]] kept its [[cycle]] turning.
A toy [[dart]] entered the machinery. “[[damn|Damn]]!” someone shouted. A [[cynical]] owner mocked Lin, but the [[daring]] apprentice would [[dare]] a [[dash]] to save his little [[darling]].
He stopped the machine before [[dangerous]] [[damage]]. Their [[customary]] routine changed: real [[danger]] required daily care, not jokes.
